sv: Spänningsbortfall under urtorkning
en: Voltage failure during screed drying
sv_detail: Larmet ges om spänningen bryts under pågående urtorkningsprogram. Programmet återupptas automatiskt när spänningen kommer tillbaka, om inte avbrottet varat längre än reglercentralens batterireserv eller inställd maxtid (normalt 12 h).
en_detail: The alarm is given if power is lost during ongoing screed drying program. The program is automatically resumed when the power is back, unless the interruption outlasts the battery reserve of the control unit, or if the set maximum time (normally 12 h) has been exceeded.
source: https://bosch-de-de.boschhc-documents.com/download/pdf/file/6721823168#page=12 (Bosch Service Manual 'A/W semi monoblock' (Compress 7000i AW / 6000 AW, Buderus WLW196i, IVT AirX), EN)

sv_detail: Modulen för extern rumsgivare har inte installerats. Larmet triggas om installatören ändå gör inställningen att styra en värmekrets med denna. Larmet är fördröjt med 4 minuter.
en_detail: The module for external room temperature sensor has not been developed. The alarm is triggered if the installer still selects this module to control a heating circuit. The alarm is delayed by 4 minutes. (Also see alarm 3091.)

sv: Ingen kommunikation med shuntmodul
en: No communication with mixer module
sv_detail: En shuntmodul har tidigare installerats för värmekrets 1 och ny lyckas installatörsmodulen inte kommunicera med shuntmodulen över EMS-bussen.
en_detail: A mixing module has previously been installed for heating circuit 1, and now the installer board has been unable to communicate with the mixing module over the EMS bus for the past 4 minutes. The alarm is automatically acknowledged when communication is re-established.

sv: Temperaturbegränsning utlöst
en: Temperature limit triggered
sv_detail: Larmet ges av shuntmodul MM100 för krets 1 om dess MC1-ingång är öppen. Det är möjligt att ansluta temperaturvakt som bryter ansluten över MC1 när temperaturen är för hög.
en_detail: The alarm is given by the mixing module MM100 for circuit 1, if its MC1 input is open. It is possibel to install a temperature guard which breaks up the connection over MC1 when the temperature is too high.
source: https://bosch-de-de.boschhc-documents.com/download/pdf/file/6721823168#page=15 (Bosch Service Manual 'A/W semi monoblock' (Compress 7000i AW / 6000 AW, Buderus WLW196i, IVT AirX), EN)

sv: Varning frysskyddet är aktivt
en: Warning Risk of frost in heating system
sv_detail: Varning om T0 (framledning), TC1 (värmebärare ut) eller TC0 (värmebärare retur) < 5°C i 10 minuter. Rensa systemfilter. Öppna termostater. Om detta inte hjälper kontakta installatör.
en_detail: Warning if T0 (flow), TC1 (heat carrier flow) or TC0 (heat carrier return) < 5°C for 10 minutes. When the warning is triggered, all available heat sources are activated and all mixing valves are opened, in order to heat the system. The warning is reset when all of the previously mentioned sensors > 25°C.
source: https://bosch-de-de.boschhc-documents.com/download/pdf/file/6721823168#page=23 (Bosch Service Manual 'A/W semi monoblock' (Compress 7000i AW / 6000 AW, Buderus WLW196i, IVT AirX), EN)

sv: Solvärmesystem har inte startats än
en: Solar thermal system not yet started
en_detail: The installer has completed the configuration of the solar module but has not approved of it to start within 15 minutes from the completion of the configuration. There is a special menu alternative under comissioning that starts the solar module, where the installer is asked if the system is filled. Answering yes to the question will start the solar module. The alarm was created because many installers would forget to start the solar module after completing its configuration. The alarm can be given again if the configuration is changed.
source: https://bosch-de-de.boschhc-documents.com/download/pdf/file/6721823168#page=43 (Bosch Service Manual 'A/W semi monoblock' (Compress 7000i AW / 6000 AW, Buderus WLW196i, IVT AirX), EN)
